##: Windows build is pinned with platformId=1; the download page's platformId=0 resolves to 1 on Windows and 4 on macOS.
The vendor API returns a dated CDN path and a build number that cannot be derived from the version; checkver captures the full URL as 'winurl' and autoupdate reuses $matchWinurl.

This is an Inno Setup 6.1 installer; innosetup=true unpacks it with innounp. Installer Run entries are not executed, so the bundled virtual audio drivers (DubbingAudio, DubbingAIAudio, AudioMirror) are left unregistered.
The bundled updater in updater/DubbingLauncher.exe may update the app outside Scoop; reinstall with 'scoop install dubbing-rtvc -f' to return to the packaged files.
description: Real-time AI voice changer with low latency and a large voice library (DubbingVC)
notes: Scoop extracts the installer rather than running it: the virtual audio drivers under DubbingAudio, DubbingAIAudio and AudioMirror are not installed. Run their install.bat files as administrator if the app cannot select its virtual microphone.
The bundled updater may replace files in the app directory outside Scoop.
